name: OH-02
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent David Taylor running with a large fundraising edge
Prediction markets price the Republican at about 98%
No polls or expert ratings to challenge the fundamentals
model.rationale: The district's R+21 lean, Taylor's incumbency and roughly $1.1 million raised against an underfunded challenger, and markets pricing the Republican near 98% all point the same way. With no polls or ratings suggesting otherwise, the fundamentals stand as the forecast.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing the challenger competitive, or major outside spending against Taylor, would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
OH-02 is a heavily Republican southern Ohio seat where first-term incumbent David Taylor is seeking re-election after winning his party's nomination. The district's partisan lean of about 21 points Republican makes a Democratic takeover a steep climb under any normal environment.

Taylor has raised about $1.1 million and holds a cash advantage, while Democrat Jennifer Mazzuckelli's fundraising is not reported. Prediction markets give the Republican roughly a 98% chance, and no expert raters list the race as competitive. Absent polling or outside spending suggesting otherwise, the seat is rated Safe Republican.
